title: VariantPropertyMergePositions
description: A property the root declares outright and a conditional consequence names again. The allOf merge folds the consequence's schema into the same property map slot, and when the two schemas disagree about the JSON type it folded by *erasing* -- so the root's own `type` and its bounds went with it and the field asserted nothing at all (issue #225). This is the mirror of #213: there a branch's constraint bound on every document, here the root's bound on none. Each property below is a separate slot with a trigger of its own, so a document naming one exercises that merge and no other, and every one carries both directions -- the root's constraint with no trigger present, and the consequence's with it.
